name: Credit Facilty
description: Regulatory Report A — sample schema (customize to your needs)

fields.name: 1. Segment Identifier
fields.description: Must contain the Value CNCF

fields.name: 2. Data Provider ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the data provider

fields.name: 3. Previous Data Provider ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the previous data provider

fields.name: 4. Data Provider Branch ID
fields.description: Conatain internal branch code of the data provider

fields.name: 5. Previous Data Provider Branch ID
fields.description: Internal branch code of the previous data provider

fields.name: 6. Credit Facility Account Number
fields.description: Credit Facility Account Number/Card Number assigned by the Data Provider

fields.name: 7. Consent Status
fields.description: Must contain the status of the consent as provided by the Subject to the Data provider

fields.name: 8. Consent Expiry Date
fields.description: Date

fields.name: 9. Primary Card Number
fields.description: Primary card number

fields.name: 10. Previous Credit Facility Account Number
fields.description: Previous credit facility account number

fields.name: 11. Previous Primary Card Number
fields.description: Previous primary card number

fields.name: 12. Approval Date
fields.description: Date of approval

fields.name: 13. Credit Limit/Approval Amount
fields.description: Credit limit or approval amount

fields.name: 14. Amount of Installment
fields.description: Amount of each installment

fields.name: 15. Highest Credit
fields.description: Highest credit amount

fields.name: 16. Currency
fields.description: Currency code

fields.name: 17. Liability Indicator
fields.description: Indicator for liability

fields.name: 18. Credit Facility Type
fields.description: Type of credit facility

fields.name: 19. Term of Loan
fields.description: Term loan in months

fields.name: 20. Repayment Type
fields.description: Type of repayment

fields.name: 21. First Disbursement Date
fields.description: Date of first disbursement

fields.name: 22. Credit Facility Account Balance
fields.description: Entire Amount including overdue portion

fields.name: 23. Last Amount Paid
fields.description: Amount paid in the last transaction

fields.name: 24. Amount Overdue
fields.description: Amount that is overdue

fields.name: 25. Number of Days Past Due
fields.description: Number of days the payment is past due

fields.name: 26. Number of Payments / Installments Overdue
fields.description: Number of payments or installments that are overdue

fields.name: 27. Asset Classification
fields.description: Classification of the asset

fields.name: 28. Account Status
fields.description: Account status for the facality

fields.name: 29. Date Latest Payment Received
fields.description: Date of Latest Payment Received

fields.name: 30. Credit Facility Amendment Date
fields.description: Date of Credit Facility Amendment

fields.name: 31. Credit Facility Write-Off Date
fields.description: Date of Credit Facility Write-Off

fields.name: 32. Secured Indicator
fields.description: Indicates if the facility is secured

fields.name: 33. Facility Nature Indicator
fields.description: Classification of the asset

fields.name: 34. Amount written off
fields.description: Amount that has been written off

fields.name: 35. Reason for Write-Off
fields.description: Reason for the write-off

fields.name: 36. Amount Forgiven
fields.description: Amount that has been forgiven

fields.name: 37. Funding Source
fields.description: Source of funding for the facility

fields.name: 38. Account Closing Date
fields.description: Date the account was closed

fields.name: 39. Amount of Unearned Interest
fields.description: Amount of unearned interest

fields.name: 40. Special Comments
fields.description: Any special comments regarding the facility

fields.name: 41. Main Action Code
fields.description: Main action code for the facility

fields.name: 42. Sub Action Code
fields.description: Sub action code for the facility

fields.name: 43. Action Date
fields.description: Date of the action

fields.name: 44. Number of Installments
fields.description: Number of installments

fields.name: 45. Collateral Amount 1
fields.description: Amount of collateral 1

fields.name: 46. Collateral Type 1
fields.description: Type of collateral 1

fields.name: 47. Credit Portfolio Purchase Indicator
fields.description: Type of Credit Portfolio purchase between two agreed parties. Set to 'No' if no purchase reported

fields.name: 48. Credit Portfolio Purchase DPID
fields.description: DPID of the Institution to which the credit facility has been Credit Portfolio purchased. Must be a valid DPID assigned by iscore

fields.name: 49. Funding Reference Code
fields.description: Required if Funding Source = 002. Format: DPID 10 digits - License no. 5 digits - 11 Alpha Numeric

fields.name: 50. Inquiry Reference Code
fields.description: Defaulted to blank

fields.name: 51. Reserved Field
fields.description: Reserved field, defaulted to blank/NULL

fields.name: 52. Transaction Type Code
fields.description: Indicates Transaction Type Code

fields.name: 53. Next Installment Date
fields.description: Due coming installment date by the subject

fields.name: 54. Special Notified Account
fields.description: Indicates whether the details reported are that of Special Notified Account

fields.name: 55. Currency in EGP
fields.description: Contains EGP Currency Code if Currency field is reported with code other than EGP

fields.name: 56. Credit Limit/Approval Amount in EGP
fields.description: Contains the Approval amount in EGP if Currency field is reported with code other than EGP

fields.name: 57. Balance in EGP
fields.description: Contains the Balance in EGP if Currency field is reported with code other than EGP

fields.name: 58. Securitization Indicator
fields.description: Flag to identify if an account has been securitized

fields.name: 59. Securitization Amount
fields.description: Total amount securitized for the Credit Facility. Required when Securitization Indicator is 001 or 002

fields.name: 60. Total Installment Per Year
fields.description: Total amount of all installments for a year for the credit facility

fields.name: 61. Number of Paid Installments
fields.description: Number of installments paid by the subject for credit facility

fields.name: 62. Income Type
fields.description: Value to identify the income type

fields.name: 63. Borrower Identification Code
fields.description: Required when Liability Indicator is 004, 010, 011, 012, 013, 014, or 016

fields.name: 64. Borrower Identification Issuing Authority
fields.description: Code of the Authority that issued the Borrower Identification Code. Required when Borrower Identification Code is reported

fields.name: 65. Issuance Date
fields.description: Issuance date of securitization. Required when Securitization Indicator is 001 or 002

fields.name: 66. Securitization Tenor
fields.description: Securitization tenor in months. Required when Securitization Indicator is 001 or 002

fields.name: 67. Issuance No
fields.description: Issuance number for securitization. Required when Securitization Indicator is 001 or 002

fields.name: 68. Issuer
fields.description: Institution to whom the portfolio has been handed over. Required when Securitization Indicator is 001 or 002

fields.name: 69. Collateral Type 2
fields.description: Collateral Type 2

fields.name: 70. Collateral Amount 2
fields.description: Collateral Amount 2. Required when Collateral Type 2 is reported

fields.name: 71. Collateral Type 3
fields.description: Collateral Type 3, specified for reporting type 402 Credit Risk Guarantee Company

fields.name: 72. Collateral Amount 3
fields.description: Collateral Amount 3. Required when Collateral Type 3 is reported

fields.name: 73. Credit Risk Guarantee Company Name
fields.description: Name of Credit Risk Guarantee Company. Required when Collateral Type 3 is reported as 402
